limitations: This manifest verifies exact source files and records their mapping to the live ledger as observed through Supabase read-only migration history. It does not query persisted migration SQL or compute live SQL hashes; the frozen 93-entry hash snapshot remains separate. Full historical replay is still unproven because the reviewed initial schema baseline is missing and the environment-specific identity mapping is intentionally redacted.
